# Free commercial-output follow-up

The user supplied renewed QuillBot detector access during the follow-up on 2026-10-03. This did not authorize a purchase; none was made.

## QuillBot Humanizer

The visible language selector listed four English dialects, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish. Korean was absent. The full 134-word English archive source was submitted in English (UK). The output panel displayed `134/125 words. Limit exceeded.` and required upgrading to view the text. The restricted/masked output was not extracted, reconstructed, accepted or detector-tested. No payment or paid trial was started. This is an access-limit observation, not a complete vendor-output comparison. See the [language receipt](quillbot-language-receipt.txt), [limit receipt](quillbot-limit-receipt.txt) and [metadata](quillbot-limit-observation.json).

## Undetectable Basic

The public, signed-out Basic / General Writing mode with the Undetectable switch off processed the whole Korean library source. Its [raw output](undetectable-ko-library-raw.txt) and [visible input/output excerpt](undetectable-ko-library-receipt.txt) are archived. The provider's own UI showed **50% AI / GPT** and `Your text is written by AI`. This is not a GPTZero or QuillBot scan, not a Human probability, and not included in the external-detector observation count.

The raw output was rejected before independent detector submission. The parent source comparison found:

- `구분할 필요가 있다`, `전달해야 한다`, `고려해야 한다`, `설명해야 한다`, `확인해야 한다` and `점검할 필요가 있다` had become bare actions, losing the original recommendation/requirement force.
- Volunteer participation had changed from unresolved to unverified. A condition that was hard to defer as an after-start detail had become something hard to solve after operations began.
- The source's causal-evidence qualifier and its statement that maintaining the limit permits discussion without overinterpretation were weakened or shortened.
- The output contained repeated double spaces and a mix of present/past reporting. These were not adopted as humanization techniques.

The parent produced a separately labelled [repaired derivative](../inputs/ko-library-vendor-repaired.txt), preserving the vendor's relatively direct clause structure while restoring these source constraints and normal spacing. It then compared every source paragraph and read the full result. A separate session performed a follow-up source/final review without the provider's scores. This derivative is **commercial output plus local editing**, not output produced solely by the portable v1.6.0 skill and not an implementation of the provider's trained model. Its own exact-text detector observations are recorded separately.

These probes do not evaluate the providers' paid tiers. A free limitation or a failure on this selected source says nothing conclusive about every mode, language or document.
